```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_project_root = os.environ.get("BGG_PROJECT_ROOT") or os.getcwd()
if _project_root not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _project_root)

import json
from collections import defaultdict

import fsspec

# Resolve `local` to the canonical models/collections path.
if source == "local":
    artifacts_root = str(
        (Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "models" / "collections")
        if "__file__" in dir()
        else Path(_project_root) / "models" / "collections"
    )
else:
    artifacts_root = source.rstrip("/")

# Discover users + their newest finalized candidate by listing the tree.
fs = fsspec.filesystem("gs" if artifacts_root.startswith("gs://") else "file")
prefix = artifacts_root.removeprefix("gs://") if artifacts_root.startswith("gs://") else artifacts_root


def _ls_dirs(p: str) -> list[str]:
    if not fs.exists(p):
        return []
    return [Path(x).name for x in fs.ls(p) if fs.isdir(x)]


users_summary: list[dict] = []
for user in sorted(_ls_dirs(prefix)):
    user_path = f"{prefix}/{user}"
    # We only surface users with a finalized "own" model — that's what
    # the per-user reports currently render.
    own_path = f"{user_path}/own"
    if not fs.exists(own_path):
        continue
    finalized: list[dict] = []
    for cand in _ls_dirs(own_path):
        for v in sorted(_ls_dirs(f"{own_path}/{cand}")):
            if not v.startswith("v"):
                continue
            reg_path = f"{own_path}/{cand}/{v}/registration.json"
            final_path = f"{own_path}/{cand}/{v}/finalized.pkl"
            if not (fs.exists(reg_path) and fs.exists(final_path)):
                continue
            try:
                with fs.open(reg_path, "rt") as fh:
                    reg = json.load(fh)
            except Exception:
                continue
            finalized.append((cand, int(v[1:]), reg))
    if not finalized:
        continue
    # Pick the most recently finalized (latest finalized_at) version.
    finalized.sort(key=lambda x: x[2].get("finalized_at") or "", reverse=True)
    cand, version, reg = finalized[0]
    spec = reg.get("candidate_spec") or {}
    cfg = spec.get("classification_config") or spec.get("regression_config") or {}
    users_summary.append({
        "username": user,
        "candidate": cand,
        "version": version,
        "model_type": (cfg.get("model_type") or "—"),
        "roc_auc": (reg.get("metrics") or {}).get("roc_auc"),
        "pr_auc": (reg.get("metrics") or {}).get("pr_auc"),
        "finalized_at": reg.get("finalized_at"),
        "n_train": reg.get("n_train_used"),
    })
```

```{python}
#| label: user-grid
#| output: asis
def _fmt(v, decimals=3):
    if v is None:
        return "—"
    try:
        return f"{float(v):.{decimals}f}"
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return str(v)


def _short_dt(value):
    if not value:
        return "—"
    return str(value).split("T")[0]


# Overlay on-disk discovery: which of the two report HTMLs actually
# exist for each user, so a card links only to reports that rendered.
from src.reports.output_index import discover_output_reports

_present = {
    r["username"]: r
    for r in (discover_output_reports(output_dir) if output_dir else [])
}

if not users_summary:
    print("_No reports have been generated yet._")
else:
    print("```{=html}")
    print('<div class="user-grid">')
    for u in users_summary:
        name = u["username"]
        flags = _present.get(
            name, {"has_predictions": True, "has_model": False}
        )
        links = []
        if flags["has_predictions"]:
            links.append(f'<a href="{name}.html">Predictions</a>')
        if flags["has_model"]:
            links.append(f'<a href="model/{name}.html">Model</a>')
        links_html = " · ".join(links) if links else "—"
        print(
            f'<div class="user-card">'
            f'<div class="user-card-title">{name}</div>'
            f'<div class="user-card-sub">'
            f'{u["model_type"]} · ROC-AUC {_fmt(u["roc_auc"])}'
            f'</div>'
            f'<div class="user-card-links">{links_html}</div>'
            f'</div>'
        )
    print("</div>")
    print("```")
```

## About

Each report below summarizes a per-user classification model that
predicts whether the user owns a given board game on BoardGameGeek.
Models learn from features observable at release — publishers,
mechanics, designers, playing time — and never read BGG community
signals like average rating or weight, so they can score upcoming
games without leaking signal from the community after release.

```{python}
#| label: summary-table
import pandas as pd

if users_summary:
    df = pd.DataFrame([
        {
            "User": f'<a href="{u["username"]}.html">{u["username"]}</a>',
            "Model": u["model_type"],
            "Candidate": u["candidate"],
            "ROC-AUC": _fmt(u["roc_auc"]),
            "PR-AUC": _fmt(u["pr_auc"]),
            "Train rows": (
                f'{int(u["n_train"]):,}'
                if u["n_train"] is not None
                else "—"
            ),
            "Finalized": _short_dt(u["finalized_at"]),
        }
        for u in users_summary
    ])
    from itables import show as itables_show
    itables_show(
        df,
        paging=False,
        searching=False,
        info=False,
        classes="display compact",
        style="width: 100%",
        allow_html=True,
    )
```
